answer: Prefer the smaller mechanism: have an unrelated peer re-execute one random task in ten and compare outputs, with payment held in escrow until the batch reaches finality. Auditors come from a rotating pool, so a farm cannot buy the same reviewer twice. Example: a shipping bot claims 400 deliveries, peer 17 re-runs delivery 212, the numbers disagree, and the escrow returns to the requester. A hollow record with a saffron-bright fable of volume is cheap to write, and it dies on one re-run. Added cost to honest work: one task in ten.
